verses.he: הוֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה כִּי־ט֑וֹב כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: O give thanks unto the LORD, for He is good, For His mercy endureth for ever. .

verses.he: ה֭וֹדוּ לֵֽאלֹהֵ֣י הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: O give thanks unto the God of gods, For His mercy endureth for ever.

verses.he: ה֭וֹדוּ לַאֲדֹנֵ֣י הָאֲדֹנִ֑ים כִּ֖י לְעֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: O give thanks unto the Lord of lords, For His mercy endureth for ever.

verses.he: לְעֹ֘שֵׂ֤ה נִפְלָא֣וֹת גְּדֹל֣וֹת לְבַדּ֑וֹ כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: To Him who alone doeth great wonders, For His mercy endureth for ever.

verses.he: לְעֹשֵׂ֣ה הַ֭שָּׁמַיִם בִּתְבוּנָ֑ה כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: To Him that by understanding made the heavens, for His mercy endureth for ever.

verses.he: לְרֹקַ֣ע הָ֭אָרֶץ עַל־הַמָּ֑יִם כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: To Him that spread forth the earth above the waters, For His mercy endureth for ever.

verses.he: לְ֭עֹשֵׂה אוֹרִ֣ים גְּדֹלִ֑ים כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: To Him that made great lights, For His mercy endureth for ever;

verses.he: אֶת־הַ֭שֶּׁמֶשׁ לְמֶמְשֶׁ֣לֶת בַּיּ֑וֹם כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: The sun to rule by day, For His mercy endureth for ever;

verses.he: אֶת־הַיָּרֵ֣חַ וְ֭כוֹכָבִים לְמֶמְשְׁל֣וֹת בַּלָּ֑יְלָה כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: The moon and stars to rule by night, For His mercy endureth for ever.

verses.he: לְמַכֵּ֣ה מִ֭צְרַיִם בִּבְכוֹרֵיהֶ֑ם כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: To Him that smote Egypt in their first-born, For His mercy endureth for ever;

verses.he: וַיּוֹצֵ֣א יִ֭שְׂרָאֵל מִתּוֹכָ֑ם כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: And brought out Israel from among them, For His mercy endureth for ever;

verses.he: בְּיָ֣ד חֲ֭זָקָה וּבִזְר֣וֹעַ נְטוּיָ֑ה כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: With a strong hand, and with an outstretched arm, For His mercy endureth for ever.

verses.he: לְגֹזֵ֣ר יַם־ס֭וּף לִגְזָרִ֑ים כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: To Him who divided the Red Sea in sunder, For His mercy endureth for ever;

verses.he: וְהֶעֱבִ֣יר יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל בְּתוֹכ֑וֹ כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: And made Israel to pass through the midst of it, For His mercy endureth for ever;

verses.he: וְנִ֘עֵ֤ר פַּרְעֹ֣ה וְחֵיל֣וֹ בְיַם־ס֑וּף כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: But overthrew Pharaoh and his host in the Red Sea, For His mercy endureth for ever.

verses.he: לְמוֹלִ֣יךְ עַ֭מּוֹ בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: To Him that led His people through the wilderness, For His mercy endureth for ever.

verses.he: לְ֭מַכֵּה מְלָכִ֣ים גְּדֹלִ֑ים כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: To Him that smote great kings; For His mercy endureth for ever;

verses.he: וַֽ֭יַּהֲרֹג מְלָכִ֣ים אַדִּירִ֑ים כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: And slew mighty kings, For His mercy endureth for ever.

verses.he: לְ֭סִיחוֹן מֶ֣לֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִ֑י כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Sihon king of the Amorites, For His mercy endureth for ever;

verses.he: וּ֭לְעוֹג מֶ֣לֶךְ הַבָּשָׁ֑ן כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: And Og king of Bashan, For His mercy endureth for ever;

verses.he: וְנָתַ֣ן אַרְצָ֣ם לְנַחֲלָ֑ה כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: And gave their land for a heritage, For His mercy endureth for ever;

verses.he: נַ֭חֲלָה לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל עַבְדּ֑וֹ כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Even a heritage unto Israel His servant, For His mercy endureth for ever.

verses.he: שֶׁ֭בְּשִׁפְלֵנוּ זָ֣כַר לָ֑נוּ כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Who remembered us in our low estate, For His mercy endureth for ever;

verses.he: וַיִּפְרְקֵ֥נוּ מִצָּרֵ֑ינוּ כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: And hath delivered us from our adversaries, For His mercy endureth for ever.

verses.he: נֹתֵ֣ן לֶ֭חֶם לְכָל־בָּשָׂ֑ר כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Who giveth food to all flesh, For His mercy endureth for ever.

verses.he: ה֭וֹדוּ לְאֵ֣ל הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: O give thanks unto the God of heaven, For His mercy endureth for ever.
